core_obligations: Embed: present the spectral space as a limit of finite sober spaces and hence as a closed subset of the product of the corresponding finite discrete spaces (proof lines 4884-4898)
Constructibly closed: the subset is cut out inside the product by the closed conditions expressing compatibility with the transition maps (proof lines 4899-4910)
Compare: the limit of the images agrees with the given space, and both are closed in the same product, so the identification follows (proof lines 4911-4917)
proof_roadmap: 把谱空间写成有限 sober 空间的定向逆向极限 ⇒ 实现为相应有限离散空间之积中的子集。
该子集由各转移映射的相容条件（闭条件）截出 ⇒ 在可构造拓扑中闭。
比较两侧在该积中的闭子集：由极限描述与「闭子集仍谱」确认二者相同。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every spectral space is a subset of a product of two-point spaces which is closed in the constructible topology (author lemma at source lines 4876-4882, label lemma-spectral-closed-in-product-two-point-space). The proof (source lines 4884-4918) realises the space as a limit of finite sober spaces, embeds it in the product of the corresponding finite discrete spaces, shows the image is cut out by closed compatibility conditions and compares the two descriptions (proof lines 4884-4917). The construction of the closed subset and the comparison are the substance. H3.
